_about: AI-assisted: researched and assembled with ChatGPT (OpenAI). See docs/AI_USAGE.md. Eight 2019 DOJ San Diego indictments identify 85 distinct defendants in eight case-based alleged networks: 79 named in drug-conspiracy Count 1, five only in separate individual drug counts, and Erika Marlene Ramirez-Ramirez in drug-proceeds-laundering Count 2 only. The status is historical as of the 2019-09-19 unsealing; later case outcomes were not verified. Case affiliation is not direct Sinaloa Cartel membership. No co-defendant pairwise edges, Mexico markers from hometown, precise or live locations, or photos are included. U.S. association derives solely from each person’s named count alleging conduct within the Southern District of California and elsewhere, and does not establish residence or present location.
